instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, bracing himself. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) balances on her left leg, kicking her right leg forward towards his hip. The two interact as she executes the kick. The scene is brightly lit by overhead lights, revealing motion capture cameras and tripods in the background.
